title: ️‍♂️ Hawaii Five-O, Linear Algebra, and the Limits Of AI Music :emoji:
content:
We keep hearing that AI is about to transform everything and deliver a big beautiful future.

But in the world of music-making, things aren't quite so "brilliant". MeFite flug has been experimenting with AI music tools, and discovered some surprisingly firm boundaries. Drawing on the tv show Hawaii 5-0 and a bit of Linear Algebra nerdery, flug maps out where the tools shine and, more importantly, where they're still in the dark.
author: Brandon Blatcher
